title: Authentik
description: Identity platform health, sign-ins, LDAP and proxy outposts, workers, database, and host capacity. Map Prometheus and an OpenSearch data source for Graylog message indexes using timestamp as the time field. The default scrape jobs are authentik, node-exporters, cadvisor, and uptime-kuma. Set the dashboard variables to the labels and URLs in your deployment.

list.name: exporter_host
list.label: Exporter host
list.description: Server label on the node-exporters and cadvisor scrape jobs.

list.name: uptime_monitor
list.label: Uptime Kuma monitor
list.description: Monitor name label on the uptime-kuma scrape job.

list.name: log_source
list.label: Graylog source
list.description: Source field on the Authentik records in Graylog.

list.name: authentik_url
list.label: Authentik URL
list.description: Authentik base URL without a trailing slash.

list.name: graylog_url
list.label: Graylog URL
list.description: Graylog base URL without a trailing slash.

panels.title: Web reachability
panels.description: The internal Uptime Kuma HTTP monitor for Authentik.

panels.title: Metrics targets up
panels.description: Expected targets are Authentik server and worker.

panels.title: Connected workers
panels.description: Reported worker count. Both metrics endpoints report the same count.

panels.title: Connected outposts
panels.description: The embedded proxy and the LDAP outpost as reported by Authentik.

panels.title: Queued jobs
panels.description: Current worker queue depth across task types.

panels.title: Web latency p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of measured Django request latency over the last 15 minutes.

panels.title: Most-run background tasks
panels.description: Share of executions among the six most active background tasks over the selected range.

panels.title: Cached flows and policies
panels.description: Entries currently held in the flow and policy caches. Both metrics endpoints can report the same cache count.

panels.title: HTTP responses by status
panels.description: Responses per second from Authentik's Django application, including health checks.

panels.title: HTTP latency
panels.description: Rolling 15-minute percentiles across all Django requests.

panels.title: Requests by destination
panels.description: Requests routed to Authentik core and its embedded outpost.

panels.title: Busiest HTTP handlers
panels.description: Top handlers by request count over the selected range.

panels.title: Recorded successful sign-ins and failure markers
panels.description: Graylog counts Authentik server audit records for successful sign-ins and login_failed messages for failures. These series describe recorded activity and cannot establish a success ratio.

targets.query: source:${log_source:lucene} AND container_name:${log_server:lucene} AND message:"authentik.events.models" AND message:"action login"

panels.title: Outpost connections
panels.description: Server-reported active connection count per outpost. A missing time series leaves a gap.

panels.title: Outpost heartbeat age
panels.description: Elapsed time since Authentik last received an update from each outpost.

targets.expr: clamp_min(time() - max by (outpost) (authentik_outposts_last_update{job="authentik",outpost=~"LDAP Outpost|authentik Embedded Outpost"}), 0)

panels.title: Flow plans by flow
panels.description: New plans built per rolling 15 minutes. Cached flow plans can reduce this count.

panels.title: LDAP flow planning latency
panels.description: Rolling one-hour duration of new LDAP authentication flow plans. Gaps indicate no new samples.

panels.title: Authentication stage latency p95
panels.description: Rolling one-hour latency by stage type across Authentik flows.

panels.title: Policy engine latency p95
panels.description: Rolling one-hour policy engine latency grouped by evaluated object type.

panels.title: Worker queue and running jobs
panels.description: Current counts across worker queues.

panels.title: Jobs executed by queue
panels.description: Worker task executions per rolling 15 minutes.

panels.title: Task duration p95 by type
panels.description: Eight slowest task types with observations over the selected range.

panels.title: PostgreSQL query throughput
panels.description: Queries per second observed by Authentik’s application and worker.

panels.title: PostgreSQL query latency p95
panels.description: Rolling 15-minute p95 measured by the Authentik process issuing the query.

panels.title: PostgreSQL new connections
panels.description: New connections opened by the server and worker per rolling 15 minutes.

panels.title: Container CPU
panels.description: 100% is one fully used CPU core.

panels.title: Container memory working set
panels.description: cAdvisor working set for the Authentik services, LDAP outpost, and PostgreSQL.

panels.title: Container uptime
panels.description: Time since each container last started, based on cAdvisor. A restart or replacement resets the series for that service.

panels.title: Root filesystem utilization
panels.description: Space unavailable to unprivileged processes on the Authentik host root filesystem.

panels.title: Metrics scrape duration
panels.description: Time Prometheus took to collect metrics from each endpoint.

panels.title: Auth service log volume
panels.description: Graylog messages per graph bucket from each container.
